subject: Partnership idea — protecting the leads you generate for chiros
body:
Hi Chase,

I came across Focus Digital and your work driving organic patient leads for chiropractors. I run a small studio that builds AI phone receptionists for local service businesses, and I think there's a clean partnership here — so I wanted to float it.

Here's the gap I keep seeing: an agency does great work generating new-patient calls, but a solo chiro office has no one answering the phone after hours (or when they're mid-adjustment). The lead rings out, calls the next office, and your beautiful SEO results quietly leak out the bottom of the funnel — which makes your work look less effective than it actually is.

The idea: we partner, white-labeled under Focus Digital. You keep generating the demand; I build and manage AI receptionists for your clients that answer every call 24/7, book appointments, and capture after-hours leads — all under your brand. We split the monthly retainer. It's a new recurring revenue line for you and a stickier client relationship, with none of the build/support work on your plate.

Worth a quick 15-minute call to see if it's a fit? No pressure either way.

Best,
Leo Lebel
cheddar.lebel@gmail.com
